description: This Java class 'SoapSerializer' provides static methods to serialize and deserialize objects to and from XML, serving as a bridge between SOAP processing and legacy XML serialization code within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: SoapSerializer
classes.description: A facade class used to connect SOAP code to the legacy XML serialization code, providing static serialization and deserialization methods.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts XML content string into an object by parsing XML and deserializing via XmlSerializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts an object into its XML string representation using XmlSerializer.
